facts.fact: Presidential Decree 272/24, published in Diario da Republica I Serie n.º 231 on 5 December 2024 after Council of Ministers review on 30 August 2024, approves the ICT White Paper 2023-2027 (period 2023-2027, still running), whose stated objective is universal access of the whole population to the universal broadband service and which names the National Broadband Strategy and the National Broadband Network (RNBL) as its basis; no numeric coverage, speed or price target appears in the text held.
